# Summary

Create histograms of IgG levels to enteric antigens

# Preamble

```{r preamble}
library(here)
here()
#----------------------------
# source the config file
#----------------------------
source(here("R","0-config.R"))

```

# Load the Luminex IgG data

```{r load antibody data}
#-------------------------------
# load the formatted MBA data
# for EcoMID, created by
# 0-all_sero_results_dataclean.Rmd
#
# data are in long format
#-------------------------------
d <- read_rds(file = here("../../data/bangl/luminex/final/",
                           "washb_bangl_luminex_igg_seropos_2026-03-17.rds")) 


#-------------------------------
# filter to relevant antigens
# relevel antigen labels for
# plotting in order
#-------------------------------
d1 <- d %>%
  filter(antigen %in% c(
    "norogi5", "norogii3", "norogii4", "norogii6", "norogii17",
    "etec", "p18", "p39", "ipab", "hyle", "salb", "sald",
    "osp_inaba", "osp_ogawa", "cp17", "cp23", "vsp5", "leca",
    "t24h", "es33", "nie"
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    antigen_plot = antigen_lab,
    antigen_plot = recode(
      antigen_plot,
      "Salmonella HylE" = "Salmonella HlyE"
    ),
    antigen_plot = factor(
      antigen_plot,
      levels = c(
        "Norovirus GI_5", "Norovirus GII_3",
        "Norovirus GII_4", "Norovirus GII_6",
        "Norovirus GII_17", "LT-ETEC LTB",
        "Campylobacter p18", "Campylobacter p39",
        "Shigella IpaB", "Salmonella HlyE",
        "Salmonella LPS B", "Salmonella LPS D",
        "V. cholerae OSP-Inaba", "V. cholerae OSP-Ogawa",
        "Cryptosporidium Cp17", "Cryptosporidium Cp23",
        "Giardia VSP-5", "E. histolytica LecA",
        "T. solium T24", "T. solium Es33",
        "Strongyloides NIE"
      )
    )
  )


#-------------------------------
# filter to 6-12 months old
#-------------------------------
d2 <- d1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(agemonth), between(agemonth, 6, 12))


#-------------------------------
# filter to visit 1 and 2
#-------------------------------
d3 <- d1 %>%
  filter(visit == 1 | visit == 2)

#-------------------------------
# cutoff columns:
# mficut_cdc = external/ROC-based cutoff (solid line)
# mficut_pec = pre-exposed cohort cutoff (dashed line)
# mficut_desc labels which type(s) apply per antigen
#-------------------------------
table(d1$antigen_plot, d1$mficut_desc)


```


# Create histograms of IgG values (all samples)

```{r distributions of igg}

# custom log labels
log10labs <- c( 
  expression(10^0),
  expression(10^1),
  expression(10^2),
  expression(10^3),
  expression(10^4),
  expression(10^5)
)


# mfi cutoffs
# mficut_cdc = external/ROC-based cutoff -> solid line
# mficut_pec = pre-exposed cohort cutoff -> dashed line
# Strongyloides has no pre-exposed cohort cutoff estimate
# (too few seroconversions) - filtering on !is.na(mficut_pec)
# means it will only show the solid (external/ROC) line
d_mficut_roc <- d1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(mficut_cdc)) %>%
  group_by(antigen_plot) %>%
  select(antigen_plot, mficut_cdc) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(log10mficut = log10(mficut_cdc),
         cutoff_type = "External / ROC-based") %>%
  select(antigen_plot, log10mficut, cutoff_type)

d_mficut_preexp <- d1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(mficut_pec), antigen_plot != "Strongyloides NIE") %>%
  group_by(antigen_plot) %>%
  select(antigen_plot, mficut_pec) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(log10mficut = log10(mficut_pec),
         cutoff_type = "Pre-exposed cohort") %>%
  select(antigen_plot, log10mficut, cutoff_type)

d_mficut <- bind_rows(d_mficut_roc, d_mficut_preexp) %>%
  mutate(cutoff_type = factor(cutoff_type, levels = c("External / ROC-based", "Pre-exposed cohort")))

plot_igg_dists <- ggplot(data=d1, aes(x=log10mfi)) +
  facet_wrap(.~ antigen_plot,ncol=3, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1, fill = "#0072B2",color = NA, alpha=1) +
  geom_vline(
    data = d_mficut,
    aes(xintercept = log10mficut, linetype = cutoff_type),
    color = "gray30"
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "Cutoff",
    values = c(
      "External / ROC-based" = "solid",
      "Pre-exposed cohort" = "dashed"
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:5, labels = log10labs) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 5)) +
  labs(
    x = "Luminex IgG response (MFI-bg)",
    y = "Number of samples"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

plot_igg_dists

ggsave(filename = here("output","manuscript-figures","washbb_igg_allsamples_distributions.png"),plot_igg_dists, device = "png",height = 180,width=180, units = "mm")

```


# Create histograms of IgG values (6-12 months)

# Strongyloides has no pre-exposed cohort cutoff estimate
# (too few seroconversions), so it will only show the

  group_by(antigen_plot) %>%
  select(antigen_plot, mficut_cdc) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(log10mficut = log10(mficut_cdc),

d2_mficut_preexp <- d2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(mficut_pec), antigen_plot != "Strongyloides NIE") %>%
  group_by(antigen_plot) %>%
  select(antigen_plot, mficut_pec) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(log10mficut = log10(mficut_pec),

  select(antigen_plot, log10mficut, cutoff_type)

d2_mficut <- bind_rows(d2_mficut_roc, d2_mficut_preexp) %>%

plot_igg_dists_2 <- ggplot(data=d2, aes(x=log10mfi)) +

  theme_classic() +

ggsave(filename = here("output","manuscript-figures","washbb_igg_6-12months_distributions.png"),plot_igg_dists_2, device = "png",height = 180,width=180, units = "mm")

# Create histograms of IgG values (visits 1 and 2)

```{r distributions of igg visit and 2}

# mfi cutoffs
# Strongyloides has no pre-exposed cohort cutoff estimate
# (too few seroconversions), so it will only show the
# solid (external/ROC) line
d3_mficut_roc <- d3 %>%
  filter(!is.na(mficut_cdc)) %>%
  group_by(antigen_plot) %>%
  select(antigen_plot, mficut_cdc) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(log10mficut = log10(mficut_cdc),
         cutoff_type = "External / ROC-based") %>%
  select(antigen_plot, log10mficut, cutoff_type)

d3_mficut_preexp <- d3 %>%
  filter(!is.na(mficut_pec), antigen_plot != "Strongyloides NIE") %>%
  group_by(antigen_plot) %>%
  select(antigen_plot, mficut_pec) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(log10mficut = log10(mficut_pec),
         cutoff_type = "Pre-exposed cohort") %>%
  select(antigen_plot, log10mficut, cutoff_type)

d3_mficut <- bind_rows(d3_mficut_roc, d3_mficut_preexp) %>%
  mutate(cutoff_type = factor(cutoff_type, levels = c("External / ROC-based", "Pre-exposed cohort")))

plot_igg_dists_3 <- ggplot(
  data = d3 %>% filter(visit %in% c(1, 2)),
  aes(x = log10mfi, fill = factor(visit))
) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "visit",
    values = c(
      "1" = "darkblue",   # Visit 1: darker blue
      "2" = "#A6CEE3"  # Visit 2: lighter blue
    ),
    labels = c("Visit 1", "Visit 2")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(. ~ antigen_plot, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +

  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.1,
    position = "identity",
    color = NA,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    data = d3_mficut,
    aes(
      xintercept = log10mficut,
      linetype = cutoff_type
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "gray30"
  ) +

  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "Cutoff",
    values = c(
      "External / ROC-based" = "solid",
      "Pre-exposed cohort" = "dashed"
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 0:5,
    labels = log10labs
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 5)) +
  labs(
    x = "Luminex IgG response (MFI-bg)",
    y = "Number of samples"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

plot_igg_dists_3

ggsave(filename = here("output","manuscript-figures","washbb_igg_visit1and2_distributions.png"),plot_igg_dists_3, device = "png",height = 180,width=180, units = "mm")

```
